answer: Offset-handshake admission. Each identity must complete a request-response round whose reply lags the query by a random delay drawn from a fixed distribution, and every reply must carry a distinct arrival timestamp on a shared monotonic thread. New identities are admitted only along a vertex of the timing graph where their inter-arrival gaps look human-jittered; a batch of sybils arriving in lockstep produces hollow timing neighborhoods that fail the gap test.
